stories.title: The Moonlit Thief
stories.logline: A thief in the night village discovers his guide has been keeping a dark secret to protect him.
stories.character_look: A slender youth in ragged indigo cloaks, wearing a tarnished bronze mask covering the lower half of his face.
stories.hook: The sun is a myth in Oakhaven.
stories.full_narration: The sun is a myth in Oakhaven. Here, we wake when the shadows lengthen. I am Kael, or so I call myself. I steal secrets from the archives of the dreamless. My guide, Vane, promised me the key to my past hidden within this vault. The stone groaned as I pried it open. Inside was not treasure, but a mirror reflecting only my hollow eyes. I turned to Vane, but he looked away. The secret was not my heritage, but my end. He lied about the key to keep me from realizing I was never alive at all. Follow for the next tale. Follow for more legends from the hidden realms.

stories.title: The Debt of the Clouds
stories.logline: A cartographer receives a gift from the sky market, only to realize it is a heavy debt.
stories.character_look: A young man wearing a stained leather vest, brass goggles resting on his forehead, and stained ink-stained hands.
stories.hook: Have you ever traded your voice for a map of heaven?
stories.full_narration: Have you ever traded your voice for a map of heaven? I am Elian. I chart the winds above the Great Tempest. Today, a merchant gifted me a golden compass. It pointed not to north, but to the debts I owe the sky spirits. The merchant vanished into the mist. Suddenly, the chains of the market began to snap one by one. Every step I took required a sacrifice. The map I drew was a contract written in my own blood. I am the debt collector now. Follow for the next legend. Follow to see what happens when the sky falls.

stories.title: The Ticking Forest
stories.logline: A lantern keeper in a clockwork forest realizes that time is rewinding to an irreversible end.
stories.character_look: An older man with silver hair, wearing a heavy wax-stained coat and carrying a glowing lantern.
stories.hook: Does time move forward or does it just lose its way?
stories.full_narration: Does time move forward or does it just lose its way? I am Silas. I wind the trees. If I stop, the world falls silent. Today, a leaf fell upward. The gears are turning in reverse. My youth is returning, but my memory is fading with every second. The forest is healing, but it is erasing every mistake I ever made. I was the only one who remembered the beginning. Follow for more tales. Follow for the next stop in this infinite journey.
